sources.entry: coconutBattery - Mac battery information and statistics.

summary.name: coconutBattery
summary.one_liner: A Mac and iOS battery health monitor that shows live battery information for a Mac, iPhone or iPad.
use_cases: Checking the health and quality of a Mac battery
Diagnosing an iPhone or iPad battery over USB or Wi-Fi
Tracking battery temperature, voltage and charge rates over time
Getting alerts when battery percentage drops below a set level
Viewing internal SSD statistics on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: The page describes coconutBattery as a tool that shows live battery health information for Mac, iPhone and iPad. The free version covers basic battery diagnostics, while the Plus version adds features such as Wi-Fi connection to iOS devices, a Lifetime Analyzer (max, min and average temperature, voltage, charge/discharge rates and operating time), an advanced viewer with SSD read/write statistics, custom HTML printing templates, and notifications for low battery percentage or remaining time. Menu bar battery details and saving battery health info are also listed as features. The page states a free trial can be activated in app settings and allows 10 starts in Plus mode.
notable: Live battery health readout for Mac, iPhone and iPad
Lifetime Analyzer with temperature, voltage and charge rate ranges
Wi-Fi connection to iPhone/iPad removes need for USB
Plus version is a one-time purchase, with a free trial
caveats: Many advanced features (Lifetime Analyzer, SSD stats, Wi-Fi support, notifications, custom printing) require the paid Plus version
Requires macOS 12 Monterey or later for the current version 4; older macOS versions need older coconutBattery releases
Newer Apple randomized serial numbers prevent reading the manufacturing date of devices
